headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 30, 2026**
article:
The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance. The Cincinnati Reds also secured a win, defeating the Milwaukee Brewers 7-2 behind Chase Burns' win and Jose Trevino's 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

Several key players have been placed on the injured list, including Ryan Helsley of the Baltimore Orioles, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort. The Washington Nationals have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles.

The Washington Nationals acquired Kyle Nicolas in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles, sending shortstop Randal Diaz to Baltimore in return. The Athletics traded 3B Brett Harris to the Boston Red Sox for RHP Ben Hansen, while the Texas Rangers traded C Ben Hartl to the Chicago White Sox for RHP Ben Peoples.

top_news.title: **Pirates Take Down Phillies 6-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a 6-1 victory over the Philadelphia Phillies, with Carmen Mlodzinski earning the win. Nick Gonzales led the Pirates' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Brewers 7-2**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-2 victory over the Milwaukee Brewers, with Chase Burns earning the win. Jose Trevino led the Reds' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 3 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies Rout Marlins 14-4**
top_news.summary: The Colorado Rockies dominated the Miami Marlins, securing a 10-run victory. Jake McCarthy led the Rockies' offense with 2 hits, including a home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a 6-5 victory over the Chicago White Sox, with Tim Herrin earning the win. Brayan Rocchio led the Guardians' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Orioles Place Helsley on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-handed pitcher Ryan Helsley has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to right elbow discomfort, effective retroactive to June 30, 2026.

top_news.title: **Nationals Acquire Kyle Nicolas in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals have bolstered their roster with the addition of right-handed pitcher Kyle Nicolas, acquired in a trade with the Baltimore Orioles. Nicolas joins the Nationals after being dealt for shortstop Randal Diaz.
